title: On Demonstrating the knot to four apprentices
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：demonstrate　|　正文 354 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 demonstrate 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the director ① demonstrated the knot to four apprentices with great care, and every actor in the theatre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the director ② demonstrates the knot to four apprentices on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ demonstrate the knot to four apprentices at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ demonstrated the knot to four apprentices before — a line in the poster for August 1964 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Demonstrating the knot to four apprentices with great care, the director said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ demonstrate that the old way still worked on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Demonstrate that the old way still worked at once and never mention it again.

By 1977 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the poster, and a new actor from the next theatre ⑧ demonstrates that the old way still worked with great care every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stage, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ demonstrated the knot to four apprentices again when nobody else would.

⑩ To demonstrate the knot to four apprentices, my mother said in 1982, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the theatre remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the theatre forgets, somebody demonstrates the knot to four apprentices on the same day again and somebody must demonstrate the knot to four apprentices with great care all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 演示（一般过去式 demonstrated the knot to four apprentices：1970 年导演头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 演示（一般现在 demonstrates the knot to four apprentices：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 演示（不定式 to demonstrate the knot to four apprentices：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 演示（过去完成时 had demonstrated the knot to four apprentices：1964 年八月的戏报上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 演示（动名词 demonstrating the knot to four apprentices 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 表明（demonstrate that the old way still worked：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去表明表明老办法依旧可行）
G. v. 表明（demonstrate that the old way still worked：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 演示（后段两处：新来的演员照例 demonstrates that the old way still worked，而母亲又一次 demonstrated the knot to four apprentices）

demonstrate 意为“演示”，自那以后导演当天就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 demonstrates。
demonstrate 意为“演示”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯演示把那种打结法演示给四个学徒看”，此处为不定式 to demonstrate the knot to four apprentices。
demonstrate 意为“演示”，戏报里 八月 那行字说明早在 1977 年之前就有人演示过，故用过去完成时 had demonstrated。
demonstrate 意为“演示”，导演说“演示把那种打结法演示给四个学徒看这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 demonstrating the knot to four apprentices 作主语。
demonstrate 意为“表明”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去表明表明老办法依旧可行”，should ever 之后用原形 demonstrate that the old way still worked。
demonstrate 意为“表明”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻表明表明老办法依旧可行（demonstrate that the old way still worked at once），以后再也不要提起。
demonstrate 意为“演示”，新来的演员每个夜晚都照例表明表明老办法依旧可行，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 demonstrates。
demonstrate 意为“演示”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次小心翼翼地演示把那种打结法演示给四个学徒看，用一般过去式 demonstrated 叙述。
demonstrate 意为“演示”，结尾那句是母亲 1982 年的话：要演示把那种打结法演示给四个学徒看，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和戏院记住的那一件。

导演说过，小心翼翼地演示把那种打结法演示给四个学徒看这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（demonstrating the knot to four apprentices 作主语）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 demonstrate 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1970 the director demonstrated the knot to four apprentices with great care, and nobody in the theatre forgot it.
Even now the director demonstrates the knot to four apprentices on the same day whenever the theatre asks.
Demonstrating the knot to four apprentices with great care, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever demonstrate that the old way still worked on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new actor from the next theatre demonstrates that the old way still worked with great care every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother demonstrated the knot to four apprentices again, and the theatre remembered that half.
